Topics · Meaning and purpose

What is my role on earth if my job is ordinary?

Stewardship is more than a ruler's title. It is everyone's role: build where you are, share what is entrusted.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَكُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَـٰتٍ لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And it is He who has made you successors upon the earth and has raised some of you above others in degrees [of rank] that He may try you through what He has given you. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful.

Quran · Al-An'am 6:165

Translation

“O God of my ancestors and Lord of mercy, who made all things by your word; and by your wisdom you formed man, that he should have dominion over the creatures that were made by you, and rule the world in holiness and righteousness, and execute judgment in uprightness of soul,

Original · Ancient Greek

Θεὲ πατέρων καὶ Κύριε τοῦ ἐλέους σου, ὁ ποιήσας τὰ πάντα ἐν λόγῳ σου, καὶ τῇ σοφίᾳ σου κατεσκεύασας ἄνθρωπον, ἵνα δεσπόζῃ τῶν ὑπὸ σοῦ γενομένων κτισμάτων, καὶ διέπῃ τὸν κόσμον ἐν ὁσιότητι καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ, καὶ ἐν εὐθύτητι ψυχῆς κρίσιν κρίνῃ·

Wisdom · 9:1-3

World English Bible

Many minds tie the word khalifa to government. But this verse addresses people at large: He made you successors on the earth. It mentions ranks, some above and some below, and all face one test: what they were given. The nurse, the driver, the teacher and the minister stand under the same question. The role does not change with the post. Only the trust does.

A question for you

What do you do at work that no one sees?

If you sayI do it properly.
ThenThat is what the question tests: what you do when no one sees.
If you sayI help my colleagues.
ThenThen you hold a trust that no paperwork records.
If you sayI have no job right now.
ThenThe verse does not tie the role to a job. What you were given remains, even in this season.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And to Thamūd [We sent] their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."

Quran · Hud 11:61

Translation

For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

Original · Hebrew

כִּי־ה֖וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי־עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃

the Psalms · 103:14

World English Bible

What does a steward do? The verse answers with one verb: He raised you from the earth and settled you there to build it up. Every road made smooth, every child taught, every patient treated falls inside that verb. On this reading ordinary work is no margin to religion; it is the role in practice. The same verse reminds us that the Lord is near and answers.

A question for you

What does your work build up, exactly?

If you sayPeople's daily lives.
ThenThen what looks like routine to you is what others lean on.
If you sayI see little good in it.
ThenThat may be so for now. The Step on work as worship may open another door.
If you sayMy family's living.
ThenThat is honourable work, and it belongs to the building the verse speaks of.

Part 3 of 3

﴿ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Believe in Allāh and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successive inheritors. For those who have believed among you and spent,[1629] there will be a great reward.

Translator's notes

[1629] In ways pleasing to Allāh.

Quran · Al-Hadid 57:7

Give to the Most High according as he has given. As your hand has found, give generously. For the Lord repays, and he will repay you sevenfold.

Sirach · 35:10-11

World English Bible

A person who holds money for someone else does not treat it as their own. The verse says: spend from what He has entrusted to you. Your salary is included. That does not mean you do not own it. It means your ownership comes with a question. This is how stewardship enters the end of the month, the moment of paying, the simple decision of whom to help.

A question for you

What changes if you see your money as a trust?

If you sayHow I spend it.
ThenThat is what the verse asks directly.
If you sayHow anxious I am about it.
ThenA good answer: one who sees themselves as a keeper may worry less.
If you sayNothing. I worked hard for it.
ThenA real objection, with a Step of its own: is my wealth really mine?

The same in the other books

Translation

Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name. But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.

וְעַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ מוֹדִ֥ים אֲנַ֖חְנוּ לָ֑ךְ וּֽמְהַֽלְלִ֖ים לְשֵׁ֥ם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃ וְכִ֨י מִ֤י אֲנִי֙ וּמִ֣י עַמִּ֔י כִּֽי־נַעְצֹ֣ר כֹּ֔חַ לְהִתְנַדֵּ֖ב כָּזֹ֑את כִּֽי־מִמְּךָ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל וּמִיָּדְךָ֖ נָתַ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃

1 Chronicles · 29:13-14

World English Bible

Translation

Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys. For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

Original · Ancient Greek

πωλήσατε τὰ ὑπάρχοντα ὑμῶν καὶ δότε ἐλεημοσύνην· ποιήσατε ἑαυτοῖς βαλλάντια μὴ παλαιούμενα, θησαυρὸν ἀνέκλειπτον ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, ὅπου κλέπτης οὐκ ἐγγίζει οὐδὲ σὴς διαφθείρει· ὅπου γάρ ἐστιν ὁ θησαυρὸς ὑμῶν, ἐκεῖ καὶ ἡ καρδία ὑμῶν ἔσται.

the Gospel (Luke) · 12:33-34

World English Bible

If thou be great, after being of none account, and hast gotten riches after squalor, being foremost in these in the city, and hast knowledge concerning useful matters, so that promotion is come unto thee; then swathe not thine heart in thine hoard, for thou art become the steward of the endowments of the God. Thou art not the last; another shall be thine equal, and to him shall come the like [fortune and station].

Ancient Egypt · Ptahhotep 30

Instruction of Ptah-hotep (Gunn, 1906)

Translation

Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy; that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share; laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

Original · Ancient Greek

Τοῖς πλουσίοις ἐν τῷ νῦν αἰῶνι παράγγελλε μὴ ὑψηλοφρονεῖν μηδὲ ἠλπικέναι ἐπὶ πλούτου ἀδηλότητι, ἀλλʼ ἐπὶ θεῷ τῷ παρέχοντι ἡμῖν πάντα πλουσίως εἰς ἀπόλαυσιν, ἀγαθοεργεῖν, πλουτεῖν ἐν ἔργοις καλοῖς, εὐμεταδότους εἶναι, κοινωνικούς, ἀποθησαυρίζοντας ἑαυτοῖς θεμέλιον καλὸν εἰς τὸ μέλλον, ἵνα ἐπιλάβωνται τῆς ὄντως ζωῆς.

1 Timothy · 6:17-19

World English Bible
